sources.title: CShapes 2.0
sources.author_or_institution: ETH Zürich International Conflict Research; Schvitz, Rüegger, Girardin, Cederman, Weidmann, and Gleditsch
sources.citation: Schvitz et al. (2022), Mapping The International System, 1886-2017: The CShapes 2.0 Dataset, Journal of Conflict Resolution 66(1), 144-161, DOI 10.1177/00220027211013563.
sources.role: Primary source for the first political-unit staging batch.
sources.limitations: The WWO snapshot is transformed and simplified from the provider data. CShapes is not a source for gameplay balance, exact administrative micro-history, or a license to use modern fallback geometry.

sources.title: Mapping The International System, 1886-2017: The CShapes 2.0 Dataset
sources.author_or_institution: Journal of Conflict Resolution; ETH Zürich ICR
sources.license: Publication terms apply; citation and source description only.
sources.role: Method and provenance reference for CShapes 2.0.
sources.limitations: The article explains dataset construction; it does not settle every local historical naming or sovereignty question.

sources.title: Existing WWO 1900 historical and canonical data at the task baseline
sources.citation: Input files are listed in pack_manifest.json; this source represents repository evidence, not an independent historical authority.
sources.license: Repository license and upstream licenses apply.
sources.limitations: Several existing files explicitly identify themselves as prototype, estimate, fallback, or gameplay-only data.

sources.title: The Statesman's Year-book: Statistical and Historical Annual of the States of the World for the Year 1900
sources.author_or_institution: Frederick Martin and John Scott Keltie, editors; Macmillan
sources.citation: 37th annual publication, revised after official returns; bibliographic record and scan locator.
sources.license: Bibliographic/citation use only; verify host and edition terms before redistributing scans.
sources.role: Primary cross-check candidate for names, capitals, government descriptions, and contemporary statistics.
sources.limitations: Contemporary terminology and boundaries require normalization; tables may use different reference dates and imperial aggregates.

sources.title: 1900 Census: Volume I. Population, Part 1
sources.author_or_institution: United States Census Office / U.S. Census Bureau
sources.citation: Final report of the Twelfth Census, taken in 1900; population, density, incorporated places, and urban/rural tables.
sources.license: U.S. government publication; repository stores citation and normalized facts only.
sources.role: High-confidence population and city source for U.S. records in a later batch.
sources.limitations: U.S.-only and uses census-specific concepts; it cannot fill global or colonial totals by itself.

sources.title: Maddison Project Database
sources.author_or_institution: Groningen Growth and Development Centre, University of Groningen
sources.citation: Historical GDP and population series with release documentation.
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 as recorded by the existing WWO economy source manifest; verify the selected release metadata.
sources.role: Bounded historical-series candidate for later population/economic staging.
sources.limitations: Series are estimates and crosswalked country concepts; they must not be converted directly into gameplay coefficients.

sources.title: Clio Infra historical datasets
sources.author_or_institution: Clio Infra / International Institute of Social History collaborators
sources.citation: Historical population and inequality datasets with source notes.
sources.license: Use the terms attached to the selected dataset release; citation-only in this batch.
sources.role: Secondary comparison source for population and urbanization estimates.
sources.limitations: Many series are harmonized to modern boundaries and must not be silently assigned to 1900 political units.
